name: Controller
description: Builds Control through status, debuff, and disruption effects.

focuses.name: Absolute Lockdown
focuses.description: Lockdown's hostile effect also applies Suppression for 4 seconds: Action Speed -20% and damage dealt -15%. Against non-immune targets, Lockdown's debuff/control application cannot miss. Non-hostile Lockdown grants the ally Unstoppable: crowd control immunity for 2 seconds.

focuses.name: Grand Manipulation
focuses.description: Lockdown affects up to 3 valid targets. Primary target receives full value. Secondary targets receive 50% value. For non-hostile abilities, spreads to nearby allies instead.

focuses.name: Control Cascade
focuses.description: When a Lockdown-empowered debuff/control effect expires or its target dies, 50% of its remaining duration or strength spreads to the nearest valid enemy. Non-hostile Lockdown effects spread 50% remaining duration to the nearest ally.

coreMechanic: Gain Control from active status and debuff effects. At 100 Control, empower the next control, debuff, curse, or damage-over-time effect.

skillTreeNodes.name: Heavy Chains
skillTreeNodes.description: Slow, root, stun, silence, fear, and displacement durations you apply are increased by 10% in PvE. Against control-immune targets, 50% of this value becomes damage dealt reduction instead.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Expose Weakness
skillTreeNodes.description: Your debuffs cause enemies to take 4% increased Effect Potency from your Essence abilities. If the target is an ally affected by your anti-control effects, your healing/barriers/buffs on them gain +4% Effect Potency.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.

skillTreeNodes.name: Disruptive Rhythm
skillTreeNodes.description: Applying a debuff/control effect reduces the target's Action Speed by 5% for 4 seconds. Against control-immune targets, reduce damage dealt by 3% instead.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities.
tradeoffs: Advanced cooldowns, target caps, and PvP coefficients can be tuned per node.

skillTreeNodes.name: Suppressive Damage
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: ControlConversion. Direct hostile Essence abilities apply Suppressed for 4 seconds. Suppressed enemies deal 4% less damage and have 4% reduced Action Speed. If the ability already applies debuff/control, the Suppressed values are increased by 50%. 6 second internal cooldown per target.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching ControlConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.
doesNotAffect: Abilities that do not match the listed tags, effect operations, or conversion flags.
True damage unless the ability explicitly allows conversion.

skillTreeNodes.name: Boss Conversion
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: ControlConversion. When an enemy resists or is immune to your debuff/control, 40% of the lost control duration or effect value becomes Weakened duration instead. Weakened reduces damage dealt by 5%. Also gain +10 Dominance and your next Essence ability against that enemy gains +6% Effect Potency. 8 second internal cooldown per enemy.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching ControlConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.

skillTreeNodes.name: Dominated Minions
skillTreeNodes.description: Mutator Group: SummonConversion + ControlConversion. Controlled allies apply a minor version of your most recent debuff to their target at 25% strength or duration. 5 second internal cooldown per ally. If no controlled ally exists, your DamageOverTime and Persistent Essence effects deal/apply +3% Effect Potency against debuffed enemies.

affects: Eligible active Essence abilities matching SummonConversion, ControlConversion.
tradeoffs: Conversion uses a +5% resource cost safety tradeoff and PvP coefficient until explicit balance values are authored.

skillTreeNodes.name: Application Training
skillTreeNodes.description: Debuff/control application chance +3% / +6%. If the ability cannot apply debuff/control, gain +2% / +4% Effect Potency against debuffed enemies.

affects: This style-tree passive while the node has ranks.

skillTreeNodes.name: Cleanse Resistance
skillTreeNodes.description: Your debuffs are 10% / 20% harder to cleanse or reduce. Against bosses, your debuffs lose 5% / 10% less duration from boss resistance rules.

affects: This style-tree passive while the node has ranks.

skillTreeNodes.name: Weakening Touch
skillTreeNodes.description: Debuffed enemies deal 2% / 4% less damage to you.

affects: This style-tree passive while the node has ranks.

skillTreeNodes.name: Cooldown Snare
skillTreeNodes.description: Applying a debuff/control effect reduces the remaining cooldown of your highest-cooldown non-style Essence ability by 0.5 / 1 second. 4 second internal cooldown.

affects: This style-tree passive while the node has ranks.

skillTreeNodes.description: Debuffed enemies have resource generation or recovery reduced by 5% / 10%. If enemies do not use resources, reduce their Action Speed by 2% / 4% instead.
